text:
olivia: Quick heads-up — sampleapp onboarding hit a weird one. Using node-sdk v0.9 + batching helper and /v1/embeddings (rerank model). Got back embeddings of length 512 but expected 768. Anyone seen this with retries/fallbacks?

sam: can you paste the exact request + response (trim floats is fine) so we can see headers/model id?

olivia: sure — request I used (simplified):
```js
await client.embeddings.create({
  model: 'redwood/rerank-1',
  input: ['doc a', 'doc b'],
  batch_size: 2,
  retry: { max_attempts: 3 }
})
```
and response (trimmed):
```json
{
  "model": "redwood/rerank-1",
  "embeddings": [ [0.001, ..., 0.123], [0.004, ..., 0.099] ],
  "embedding_dim": 512
}
```
Not sure where embedding_dim came from — the model should be 768. This breaks downstream similarity code.

maria: hmm could be a different variant returned on fallback (e.g., a compact/quantized reshaped model). Do you have the raw response headers or model_version in the metadata?

olivia: headers show x-redwood-model-variant: rerank-1-small and x-retry-count: 1. Didn't notice that until I logged.

kai: that explains it — batching helper has logic to retry on throttles using a configured "fallback_model". There was an accidental default to "rerank-1-small" in the helper config for Node. The small variant is 512-dim.

ben: yep I opened a PR last week to add a default fallback for cost/sla tiers and forgot to wire dim annotations through. Node SDK's batching helper then normalizes response shapes assuming consistent dims which breaks. My bad.

sam: any quick workaround for customers?

ben: currently you can force no fallback by passing retry: { fallback_model: null } or explicitly set model in retry path: retry: { fallback_model: 'rerank-1' }. Also a short-term patch incoming to propagate variant info in SDK.

jess: to add — Python SDK didn't pick up the buggy default because its helper reads "model_fallback" from config and ours used a different key name. So parity gap across SDKs is why only node sampleapp showed it.

olivia: thanks — I'll try the explicit fallback_model null. Any tests I can run to validate shape before sending to retriever?

kai: quick lint: after response, assert embeddings[0].length === expected_dim (768) before using. We should include that in sampleapp onboarding checklist.

ben: created internal issue DEVEX-4321 and PR #5792 to:
- remove implicit fallback default in node batching helper
- make SDK surface the returned model_variant header as response.model_variant
- add a shape-assertion example in sampleapp

devex-bot: Deploy triggered: deploy/patch/5792 to staging (started) — 2478005000

sam: nice. Once patch lands we should publish a short note on onboarding doc about the dimension mismatch/why it can happen (model variant fallback).

jess: also ping platform — we should make x-redwood-model-variant show up in API logs for customers (helpful for debug).

olivia: confirmed workaround worked locally (explicit fallback_model: null) — embedding dim back to 768. Will update onboarding quickstart and close the loop. Thanks all :raised_hands:

olivia: filing a tiny doc PR to add a checklist item: "verify embedding dim matches model spec or set fallback_model explicitly"
